First use: location setup

1. Enable Developer options in phone settings, usually by tapping Build number seven times under About phone.
2. In Developer options, select this app as the mock location app. Menu names vary by phone.
3. Return to this app and check permission status in Settings. Grant location and notification permissions when requested.

Then choose a point on the map and start simulation. Enabling Developer options alone does not select a mock location app.
Single location: start and stop

1. Open Map and choose single-location mode.
2. Search for a place or move the map, then check the center coordinates.
3. Tap Start simulation and complete any permission or credit prompt.
4. Tap Stop when finished; closing a floating tool does not stop simulation.

Selecting a point prepares it. You still need to start simulation.
Search places, coordinates and Plus Codes

1. Tap the search bar above the map.
2. Enter a place name, coordinates such as 25.0330, 121.5654, or a Plus Code.
3. Select a result and check the map before starting or saving.

You can also copy coordinates and return to the app to use the clipboard hint; disable that hint in Settings if preferred. Place search needs a connection. This guide works offline.
Use floating tools above your game

1. Tap Floating tools on the right of the map. Complete Pro unlock and permission to display over other apps.
2. Return to your game or another app and open the edge entry. Find places through search, saved places or routes.
3. The copy button beside a search result copies coordinates. Selecting a place opens a preview without moving.
4. Check the preview and tap Move here. If permissions or credits are missing, complete them in the main app first.

Collapse docks at the edge. Close removes the tool; use Stop to stop simulation. Opening the joystick replaces this tool.
Joystick: direction and speed

1. Tap Virtual joystick on the right of the map and complete Pro and overlay permission.
2. Drag the inner circle to move. Releasing it ends continuous joystick movement.
3. Walk, Bike, Drive and + / − switch preset modes; they do not change speed by 1 km/h each time.
4. Collapse and reopen as needed. Use Stop to stop simulation.

Opening floating tools replaces the joystick. Closing its window does not stop the location service.
Create, save and import routes

1. Choose route mode on the map, tap Add route, select waypoints in order and finish.
2. Save the route with a name. Choose saved routes from the Routes page.
3. For a GPX file, go to Settings → Data management → Import and choose GPX import.
4. Check waypoints, speed and mode before starting. Pause or stop as needed.

Importing or loading prepares a route; it does not automatically start playback.
Once, loop, bounce and jump

1. Load or create a route.
2. Tap the playback mode button to cycle Once → Loop → Bounce.
3. Once ends at the last point. Loop starts again at the first. Bounce returns along the route in reverse.
4. Enable Jump in the main map route panel to jump directly to each next waypoint at the selected interval.

Speed controls movement along the route; jump uses seconds per point. Floating route speed is displayed as an integer without changing the underlying speed.
Saved places, folders and sorting

1. Save a map point with a name and description.
2. Search saved places on the Locations page or filter by folder.
3. Long-press to select multiple places and move them to a folder. Use Manage to organize folders.
4. In custom-sort mode, drag the handle on the right to reorder.

Selecting a saved place centers the map. Start simulation separately to activate location mocking.
Step sync and Health Connect

1. Open Settings → Step sync → Setup guide. Follow the current Health Connect and step-write permission status.
2. Grant step-read and any required background access to the target app in that app and Health Connect. This app cannot grant permission on its behalf.
3. Enable step sync, start a simulation within the counting speed limit and check Written today.

The target app must support and sync the data. Step credits differ from the timed Pro unlock; you may start without step sync if credits run out. Jumping or excessive speed does not produce steps.
Pro subscription and ad unlock

1. Check your status and remaining time in the Pro section of Settings.
2. Subscribe or watch its rewarded ad for 6 hours of Pro. Finish the ad and receive a reward to unlock.
3. Floating tools and the joystick share Pro access. Opening one replaces the other.

Ad access expires. The Pro section shows the accumulation cap, currently 24 hours. It is not a permanent subscription or permanent ad removal, and is separate from step-sync credits.
Why will location simulation not start?

1. Check permission status and the health check in Settings.
2. If no mock location app is selected, select this app in Developer options.
3. For an unknown check or an engine error, follow the specific message; not every failure means Developer options are disabled.

For a blank map, check connectivity separately. Record the error, phone model and Android version when reporting an issue.
Missing overlay or replaced tool?

1. Check that Pro is active and display-over-other-apps permission is enabled.
2. Look for the small entry at either screen edge and tap to expand.
3. Opening the other tool replaces the first: only one is displayed at a time.

Pro expiry closes the tool. After Close, reopen it from the main map. Some apps or system screens may cover overlays.
Why does selecting a place not move me?

1. Selecting or moving the floating map only previews a point.
2. Use Copy if you only need coordinates. Copying does not move you.
3. To move, check the coordinates and tap Move here, completing any permission or credit prompt.

This prevents accidental movement while searching. Single-location mode on the main map needs Start simulation.
Why did an ad not unlock the feature?

1. Check which ad you watched: Pro ads grant timed Pro access; step-sync ads grant credits.
2. Finish the ad and receive a successful reward. Closing after it appears is not enough.
3. Check remaining time or credits in Settings. If an ad is unavailable, try later.

Timed Pro expires. If a successful reward was shown but status did not update, report the time and message; do not assume every ad playback grants access.
